name: ioredis
solves: Provides a full-featured, high-performance Redis client for Node.js with native support for Redis Cluster, Sentinel, Streams, Pub/Sub, pipelining, autopipelining, Lua scripting, and TLS — enabling applications to use Redis for caching, real-time messaging, and distributed data management.
best_for: Node.js applications requiring Redis Cluster or Sentinel support for high availability
Queue systems like BullMQ that depend on ioredis as their Redis driver
Applications needing autopipelining to maximize throughput with many concurrent Redis commands
Projects using Redis Streams, Pub/Sub, or Lua scripting that benefit from a rich, typed API
Existing codebases already built on ioredis that need continued maintenance and feature stability
skip_when: You need client-side support for Redis Stack modules like RedisJSON, RediSearch, or RedisTimeSeries out of the box (node-redis has built-in module support)
You want a serverless-friendly Redis client over HTTP without persistent TCP connections (use Upstash Redis instead)
Your project only needs a simple in-memory cache without an external Redis server (use lru-cache or node-cache)
You are building a Python application or non-Node.js backend
You need a storage-agnostic caching abstraction that can switch between Redis, Memcached, and other backends (use keyv or unstorage)

hosted_alternative.name: Upstash Redis
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Free tier with 10K commands/day; pay-as-you-go from $0.2 per 100K commands; Pro plans available
